column1: # The command registry: one row per usage line of `uak help`. Read at run time by .uak/bin/uak (dispatch, help,
# the mutation of a transaction) and by uak-mcp (which commands its tools cover); scripts/gen_registry.py writes
# the command index of .uak/docs/CLI.md from it, and kit_lint checks the three agree. Why (v5.11, architecture
# review): help, the two dispatch lists, CLI.md and the MCP tool list were five hand-kept copies that drifted.
#   name    the command (a second row of the same name only adds a usage line: run -)
#   run     exec (the script .uak/bin/NAME) · tx (one claims transaction) · a function · local:FUNCTION (no remote)
#   mutate  the function a transaction runs for it, or -
#   file    where its code lives (.uak/bin or .uak/bin/lib)
#   mcp     the MCP tool that runs it · uak_cli (through the generic tool) · shell (runs a command you pass: shell only)
